lines.text: Many learners say: I listen music every day.
Better: I listen to music every day.
To! I listen to music every day.

data.right: I listen to music every day.

native.tip: Im Deutschen „hörst“ du Musik. Im Englischen sagst du „listen to music“.
native.caption: Dir fehlt ein kleines Wort beim Musikhören! 🎧 Falsch: “I listen music every day.” Richtig: “I listen to music every day.” Hör Ama zu und sprich nach! Mehr üben in der Lexkite-App.
native.comment: Lösung: “to”. Richtig heißt es: “I listen to music every day.” Übe mehr mit einem kostenlosen Quiz: {link}

en.hook: A little word is missing when you listen to music!
en.tip: In German there is no extra word. In English you say “listen to music”.
en.caption: A little word is missing when you listen to music! Wrong: “I listen music every day.” Right: “I listen to music every day.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
